title: OpenKYCAML Travel Rule pacs.008 Profile
description: CBPR+-compliant profile for embedding OpenKYCAML Travel Rule data inside an ISO 20022 pacs.008 FIToFICstmrCdtTrf message. Defines the minimum required fields for FATF Recommendation 16 and MiCA Article 83 compliance.

profile.description: Maps IVMS 101 originator and beneficiary data to pacs.008 Dbtr/Cdtr blocks. Dynamic KYC/AML data (risk rating, screening results, VC proofs) is carried in the KYCAMLEnvelope inside <SplmtryData>.

requiredIso20022Fields.notes: UUIDv4 message identifier from OpenKYCAML envelope
Always 1 — OpenKYCAML is a single-transaction record
Default settlement method. Override for SWIFT gpi (INGA) or bilateral (INDA).
ISO 4217 fiat currency code. Use XXX for non-ISO crypto assets.
Natural person: concat secondaryIdentifier + primaryIdentifier. Legal entity: LEGL legalPersonName.
Same name mapping logic as Dbtr/Nm.

conditionalKycAmlEnvelopeFields.condition: Required when dueDiligenceType is CDD or EDD
Required when originator was onboarded via EUDI Wallet (onboardingChannel = EUDI_WALLET)
Required when kycProfile.monitoringInfo.alerts contains SAR-linked entries

addressRequirements.cbprPlus: Structured address (StrtNm + TwnNm + Ctry) required for SWIFT CBPR+ processing. Unstructured AdrLine accepted only when structured fields are unavailable.
addressRequirements.target2: Structured address mandatory for TARGET2-compliant messages.

cryptoAssetHandling.accountNumber: Carry crypto wallet address in DbtrAcct/Id/Othr/Id. Set SchmeNm/Prtry to the asset ticker (e.g. BTC, ETH).
cryptoAssetHandling.currency: Set IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy = 'XXX'. Carry full transferredAmount (amount + assetType) in KYCAMLEnvelope.kycProfile.
